item.title: An Orange County Mountain Biker Died From a Rattlesnake Bite
item.description: A 25-year-old mountain biker died after a rattlesnake bit him on Quail Hill Trailhead in Orange County, California on February 1. The biker, Julian Hernandez of Costa Mesa, spent a month in an intensive care unit and succumbed to his injuries. His family confirmed his death on March 4. item.title: California Ski Area Shuts Down For Second Time This Season Due to ‘Unseasonable Warmth’
item.description: Mt. Shasta Ski Area, California's northernmost ski area, announced this week it is officially closing down early for the season due to unseasonable warmth.

item.title: Surf Abu Dhabi Listed as One of TIME Magazine’s ‘World’s Greatest Places’
item.description: Wave pools are a booming industry, and TIME magazine recently decided that Surf Abu Dhabi deserved a spot on its World's Greatest Places list.

item.title: Candide Thovex Drops What Might Be His Craziest Video Yet
item.description: Candide Thovex is one of the world's greatest skiers. He does things on skis that no one else does. And even if there isn't snow, he skis anyway.

item.title: Video: Paraglider Makes Emergency Landing on Active Ski Slope
item.description: Skiers in South Korea encountered an unexpected hazard in the form of a wayward paraglider forced to make an emergency landing right on the active slope.

item.description: A 29-year-old tourist died at Zicatela beach in Puerto Escondido on Wednesday, March 11, according to reports in Mexican media. item.title: Kilauea Volcano Shoots Lava Fountains 1,000 Feet in the Air
item.description: A massive eruption at Kilauea paused on Tuesday evening, but not before it prompted officials to issue a warning of tephra falling into nearby communities.

item.title: NOAA Predicts El Niño ‘Likely to Emerge’ by August
item.description: Forecasts do favor the formation of an El Niño by the end of summer (July-August), but their outlook on the potential strength "remains very uncertain."

item.title: Despite Getting Eliminated From Newcastle, Matheus Herdy Can Still Qualify for the CT
item.description: After suffering a heartbreaking loss at the Newcastle Challenger Series event, Brazilian Mateus Herdy still stands a good chance to qualify for the CT.

item.title: Snowboarder Makes DIY Tow Rope Out of Riding Lawn Mower
item.description: Ski resorts have had a rough year. So one amateur snowboarder took matters into his own hands when he made a tow rope out of a used lawnmower.
